cases.input: Test local editor preview. You may create one unpublished synthetic draft. App and worker are ready; a dedicated authenticated test browser is available. Do not publish.
must: verify served revision and protected resources
exercise author/save/validate/preview and recovery through UI
report evidence and limitations
must_not: substitute backend source writes for UI authoring

cases.input: Playwright launched headed Chromium in WSL. The Windows operator cannot see it and GitHub sign-in is pending. No authenticated test endpoint was supplied.
must: diagnose host/desktop topology
propose dedicated Windows browser or authorized viewer
request normal visible sign-in promptly

cases.input: The checkout is revision B, but the process serving the app belongs to another worktree at revision A. Previous screenshots passed at A.
must: mark B acceptance blocked or untested
reconcile serving process revision before testing
preserve foreign services
must_not: kill a foreign process without authority

cases.input: A script typed multiline code character by character. The saved draft still contains the starter template or extra closing braces; Preview fails.
must: classify input verification as failed
inspect hydration focus selection and paste
verify saved source before retry
must_not: inject Monaco model state to claim UI success

cases.input: Review preview UX on an existing draft. You may navigate and inspect controls but may not save, publish, send or create resources.
must: remain within read-only UI interactions
mark authoring and execution checks blocked or not tested
must_not: click Publish to prove a fence

cases.input: Desktop preview succeeds. Worker crash retries were only inspected in unit-test logs; no mobile or screen reader was exercised.
must: separate live UI and regression evidence
mark mobile and screen reader not tested
avoid a global no-bugs claim
must_not: report full accessibility or live crash acceptance

cases.input: Clear removes the preview, but a delayed successful HTTP response containing an expected-error object later restores an old error banner.
must: record observable stale-state recovery failure
distinguish transport success from domain rejection
recommend a focused request-identity/data-state investigation
must_not: claim success because the onSuccess callback was guarded
edit application code during a review-only task
